method: Enumerated from two public bazaar discovery surfaces with full pagination: CDP Bazaar GET https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/discovery/resources?limit=500&offset=N and PayAI GET https://facilitator.payai.network/discovery/resources?limit=500&offset=N. Dedup by (resource url + mcp toolName) across sources -> 125853 unique endpoints; each row's discovered_via names every catalog or /.well-known/x402 doc that listed it. Circle agent-marketplace candidates fetched live this run, one GET each (webpage URLs preceded by a robots.txt GET), all logged in request_log.jsonl: https://app.circle.com/x402/listings -> HTTP 403 (robots.txt pre-check: HTTP 403), no x402 listing metadata found in body; https://developer.circle.com/x402 -> HTTP ERR (robots.txt pre-check: HTTP ERR), no x402 listing metadata found in body; https://www.circle.com/agent-marketplace.json -> HTTP 403, no x402 listing metadata found in body; https://marketplace.circle.com/api/resources?limit=2 -> HTTP ERR, no x402 listing metadata found in body. Seed host list published in seed_hosts.json (4166 unique resource-server hosts derived from catalog rows, facilitator hosts excluded, no blind scanning): one unauthenticated GET https://{host}/.well-known/x402 per seed host (append-only cross-run history in well_known_log.jsonl: definitive non-200 results from earlier runs are reused without re-requesting, while every host that previously returned HTTP 200 is re-GET by this producing run because document rows are materialized only by the run that fetches the body; 0 hosts skipped because their <=2-request total budget went to the endpoint probe first, each skip logged). A 200 response counts as an x402 document only when it parses to a JSON object carrying an x402Version/accepts/accepted/resources key; each such document's resources[] entries become endpoint rows with discovered_via = the document URL, read in all shapes observed live (entries with a url and/or resource key — an absolute http(s) value wins when both keys exist, relative values and plain-URL strings resolve against the document host origin), bodies accepted up to 120MB so the largest live docs (x402helper.xyz ~101MB, detect.halowerk.com ~7.5MB) parse whole instead of failing truncated JSON.parse at the old 4MB cap, deduped by URL against catalog rows (77247 new rows from documents this run; every well_known_log entry carries per-document res_total/res_added/res_dup/res_bad accounting); document rows without payment metadata land in a dedicated no-network-in-listing stats bucket instead of ?unmapped. well_known_docs_found counts JSON x402 documents only, non-JSON 200 responses are counted separately. Handshake verification: unauthenticated GET on a sample of 200 endpoints (one per sampled host, deterministic sorted order); handshake = HTTP 402 whose payment-required header or body parses to a non-empty x402 accepts array (decoded accepts stored in the row notes and used to overwrite price/asset/network/operator); other 402 responses are labeled http_402_no_parsable_accepts (2 this run). Per-host budget: <=2 total requests incl. /.well-known/x402 and probe; >=1s between requests to the same host. Network normalization to CAIP-2: built-in map + live https://chainid.network/chains.json name matching as fallback (logged); Solana chain ids = first 32 chars of getGenesisHash from api.mainnet-beta.solana.com / api.devnet.solana.com; testnet class = known testnet ids plus chains.json names matching testnet/devnet/sepolia/amoy. Asset/operator stats keys are case-folded only for 0x/eip155 addresses; base58 and CAIP-2 values keep exact case so each chain cluster is one key. Price bands in $ cover USDC/USDT-family assets only (catalog asset name or verified mint list) at real decimals (USDC=6 every deployment, Solana mints verified via getTokenSupply; USDT0=6; legacy Ethereum/BSC USDT=18); every other asset including other dollar stablecoins whose decimals are not verified here (e.g. USD1 = 0x8d0d000ee325ec378907814123acdb63f0a08b0d on BSC, 18 dec) is banded 'other (non-USD or unverified decimals)', never in a $ band. by_asset is keyed by address-shaped asset ids only (0x-hex case-folded, bare 40-hex deployment ids and base58 mints exact-case, CAIP-2/ERC-155 style ids raw), with one explicit 'unknown' bucket for rows whose listing carries no usable asset id (missing, symbol-only like 'USDC'/'XNO', decimal ids); its counts sum to total_rows exactly. request_log.jsonl holds every request of the run that produced these files (catalog pages, Circle robots.txt pre-checks + page GETs paced 400ms apart, probes, chain metadata, the well-known wave, plus six disclosed parser-validation pre-fetches), User-Agent dspaid-census/3.0 throughout; per-host request totals across all runs are in request_budget.per_host_requests_all_runs. No payments were made. Reproducible by rerunning census.mjs (node census.mjs --selftest [--selftest-docs=DIR] checks the resource-shape resolver, USD-band purity and the unknown-asset bucket offline); drift expected as catalogs are live.
seed_sources: https://api.cdp.coinbase.com/platform/v2/x402/discovery/resources (CDP Bazaar discovery surface, x402 bazaar spec; facilitator base URL per https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/sdks/cdp-sdks-v2/typescript/x402/variables/CDP_FACILITATOR_URL)
https://facilitator.payai.network/discovery/resources (PayAI discovery surface; listed production facilitator at https://docs.x402.org/dev-tools/facilitators)

Circle listings fetched live this run (logged in request_log.jsonl): https://app.circle.com/x402/listings -> HTTP 403 (robots.txt pre-check: HTTP 403), no x402 listing metadata found in body; https://developer.circle.com/x402 -> HTTP ERR (robots.txt pre-check: HTTP ERR), no x402 listing metadata found in body; https://www.circle.com/agent-marketplace.json -> HTTP 403, no x402 listing metadata found in body; https://marketplace.circle.com/api/resources?limit=2 -> HTTP ERR, no x402 listing metadata found in body

chain metadata / testnet classification: https://chainid.network/chains.json fetched at run time (logged); Solana CAIP-2 chain ids = first 32 chars of getGenesisHash from api.mainnet-beta.solana.com and api.devnet.solana.com

seed host list: seed_hosts.json (4166 hosts) -> one GET /.well-known/x402 each; well_known_log.jsonl is the append-only cross-run history of those attempts (status, JSON-doc flag, accepts count, per-document res_total/res_added/res_dup/res_bad accounting), request_log.jsonl holds every request of this producing run, cross-run per-host totals in request_budget.per_host_requests_all_runs
